newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state firm giving up majority in.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state firm giving up majority in.

text.p: An Egyptian state-owned firm offered to privatise Shams Housing and Development by putting up for sale at least 10 percent or 1.4 million shares in the company.

State-owned firm National for Construction and Development said in a published advertisement on Thursday investors could buy the shares at a minimum of 21.9 pounds -- the stock's closing price on the stock exchange on Tuesday.
The sale of the 10 percent would shrink the holding of National for Construction and Development in Shams Housing to 49.88 percent from 59.88 percent.
The state will still have a large holding in the firm through public sector banks and insurance firms.
The offer will open on Monday June 2 for three days. Individual investors can buy at least 100 shares while institutions and companies have a 5,000 share minimum.
Government-owned Misr Insurance holds 24.83 percent of Shams Housing, sister firm Shark Insurance owns another 2.50 percent and the state's Credit Foncier Egyptien Bank holds a 4.39 percent stake.
Unidentified firms own 1.27 percent of the firm while individual investors hold the remaining 7.13 percent.
Shams Housing owns minority stakes in two other construction companies whose holdings include the Sheraton Hotel in the Mediterranean town of Alexandria and the Movenpick Hotel in Cairo.

Shams Housing forecast net after-tax profits for the 1996/97 financial year, which ends on June 30, of 15.20 million pounds ($4.48 million), up from 13.46 million in 1995/96. Net sales were also expected to be higher in 96/97 at 52.93 million from 26.55 million in the previous year.
Dividends for 96/97 were also forecast higher at 1.20 pounds compard to 0.80 pounds for 95/96.

Net long-term assets at the end of 96/97 were expected to be 4.56 million compared to 4.01 million and current assets were forecast at 204.09 million compared to 176.38 million in 95/96. The firm said its current liabilities in 96/97 would be 143.87 million compared to 115.28 million.
